userStories.title: Fix Step 5.5 example + cut NotebookEdit in implementer (both copies) and re-embed
userStories.description: As the harness maintainer, I need the implementer's Step 5.5 worked example to emit a schema-valid handoff and the frontmatter to drop the unused NotebookEdit grant, so the implementer stops silently writing schema-invalid handoffs every story.
acceptanceCriteria: In BOTH subagent-implementer.md copies (.claude/agents/ and templates/agents/), the Step 5.5 worked-example handoff entry uses status "aligned" (a valid enum member) and contains NO `version` field, matching scripts/cam/handoff.schema.json. [oracle: file-assert grep -q '"status": "aligned"' .claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md && grep -q '"status": "aligned"' templates/agents/subagent-implementer.md]

Neither implementer copy's Step 5.5 example still emits the invalid status "ok" or a `version` key in the officialDocsValidated example. [oracle: file-assert ! grep -qE '"status": "ok"|"version":' .claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md && ! grep -qE '"status": "ok"|"version":' templates/agents/subagent-implementer.md]

The implementer frontmatter no longer lists NotebookEdit in the tools block in either copy; WebFetch and WebSearch are retained. [oracle: file-assert ! grep -q 'NotebookEdit' .claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md && grep -q 'WebFetch' .claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md && grep -q 'WebSearch' .claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md]
The embedded vendor copy is regenerated (bun run embed-vendor) and the drift check is clean. [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
The agent frontmatter smoke check passes for both implementer copies. [oracle: bun scripts/smoke/check-agent-frontmatter.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Vendor drift check passes (bun run embed-vendor:check). [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
userStories.notes: Files: .claude/agents/subagent-implementer.md (Step 5.5 example at ~line 134 + tools frontmatter ~line 13), templates/agents/subagent-implementer.md (same edits), then `bun run embed-vendor` to regenerate src/vendor/_generated.ts (key 'agents/subagent-implementer.md'). GOTCHA (memory: cam dual-copy is per-file): the two copies are NOT byte-identical (steps 4/2 and the exit-report line differ); edit each in place, do not copy one over the other. Only the Step 5.5 example JSON block and the frontmatter tools list change. Do NOT cut WebSearch (may be needed to find the docs URL); only NotebookEdit is a confirmed-unused grant (no notebooks in a Bun CLI). Schema reference: scripts/cam/handoff.schema.json enum [aligned, corrected, no_external_lib_touched, fetch_failed], additionalProperties:false. Frontmatter smoke lives at scripts/smoke/check-agent-frontmatter.ts.

userStories.title: Add warn-level runtime guard for handoff.officialDocsValidated
userStories.description: As the harness supervisor, I need a targeted warn-level guard where the handoff is read, so a schema-invalid officialDocsValidated entry (bad status or unknown key) surfaces a warning event instead of being consumed silently, without ever halting a healthy loop.
acceptanceCriteria: A targeted guard validates each handoff.officialDocsValidated entry where the supervisor reads the handoff: entry.status is checked against the enum [aligned, corrected, no_external_lib_touched, fetch_failed] and unknown object keys are detected. [oracle: bun test]

A violation emits a warning event (a new non-fatal WorkerEventKind); it NEVER throws or returns a hard-failure outcome that halts the loop. With a fully conformant officialDocsValidated the guard emits no warning. [oracle: bun test]
The guard is a targeted hand-rolled check: no new dependency (no ajv or other JSON-schema validator) is added to package.json. [oracle: file-assert ! grep -q 'ajv' package.json]
A unit test covers the guard: a schema-invalid entry (bad status and/or an extra key such as `version`) produces exactly one warning, and a conformant entry produces none. [oracle: bun test]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Full lint/static spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: The handoff is read at src/supervisor/loop.ts:1194 (_readHandoff()) and mapped by buildResultDetail in src/supervisor/events.ts:~525. Natural placement: a small exported validator in events.ts (near buildResultDetail / the officialDocsValidated mapper), invoked with the emit sink at the result-event site in loop.ts. Add a new WorkerEventKind (e.g. 'handoff-schema-warning') to the union at events.ts:91 and a matching detail type. GOTCHA (issue): current consumers (loop.ts:168, events.ts:478/530) read status?: string loosely and default to 'unknown' — that looseness is exactly why the invalid handoff wrote silently; the guard closes the gap by warning, not by tightening the default. GOTCHA: the guard must warn, not hard-fail — a hard failure on a minor deviation would halt an otherwise-healthy loop. Enum source of truth: scripts/cam/handoff.schema.json officialDocsValidated item (status enum + additionalProperties:false). Test under test/supervisor/ mirroring source. Independent of US-001.
